title: Zero-time advice classes are empty
statement: Let $T,a : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and suppose $T(0)=0$. Then the class of languages decidable with advice in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ is empty, regardless of the advice-length function $a$.
